Name: Easy Darts Game
Author: Dragoon23
Description:
[size=3][b]Easy Darts Game.
[/b]
Options. Everything can be turned on/off:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Target is only one size and much smaller for higher accuracy.[/size]
[*][size=3]Target will only move with cursor and no longer oscillate.[/size]
[*][size=3]Can Automatically Win (Default is off).[/size]
[/list][size=3]

All code is from scratch.[/size]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
[size=3]Config file is generated after first launch. Smaller Target and Target will Only move with Cursor are by default on. Automatically winning is off. [/size]


[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Windows.[/size]
[*][size=3]Works in single player.[/size]
[*][size=3]Should be compatible with Linux/Mac/Multiplayer but I only test for Windows/single player so can't say for sure.[/size]
[/list]
